test.query: SELECT a, b, c, sum(number), count() FROM numbers_mt(1e7) GROUP BY number % 200000 AS a, number % 3 AS b, number % 5 AS c WITH ROLLUP FORMAT Null
SELECT a, b, c, sum(number), count() FROM numbers_mt(1e7) GROUP BY number % 200000 AS a, number % 3 AS b, number % 5 AS c WITH ROLLUP FORMAT Null SETTINGS group_by_use_nulls = 1
SELECT a, b, c, avg(number), max(number) FROM numbers_mt(1e7) GROUP BY toString(number % 200000) AS a, number % 3 AS b, number % 5 AS c WITH ROLLUP FORMAT Null

SELECT k1, k2, k3, k4, k5, k6, sum(number) FROM numbers_mt(1e7) GROUP BY number % 10 AS k1, number % 100 AS k2, number % 1000 AS k3, number % 100000 AS k4, intDiv(number, 100000) % 4 AS k5, intDiv(number, 100000) % 12 AS k6 WITH ROLLUP FORMAT Null
SELECT a, sum(number) FROM numbers_mt(1e7) GROUP BY number % 1000000 AS a WITH ROLLUP FORMAT Null
SELECT a, b, sum(number) FROM numbers_mt(5e7) GROUP BY number % 100 AS a, number % 7 AS b WITH ROLLUP FORMAT Null
